question: Which Indian Navy ships took part in Operation Brahma in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Satpura and INS Savitri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Operation Brahma** was a maritime mission conducted by the **Indian Navy** in **March 2025** to strengthen maritime security and ensure safe transit in the **Indian Ocean Region**.
 
• The operation involved the deployment of **INS Satpura**, which is a **Shivalik-class** stealth multi-role frigate, and **INS Savitri**, a **Savitri-class** offshore patrol vessel.
 
• **INS Satpura** (F48) provided the necessary **stealth capabilities** and **advanced sensors** for high-intensity monitoring during the mission.
 
• **INS Savitri** (P53) acted as a versatile support and patrol platform, facilitating **maritime interdiction** and **surveillance** operations.
 
• The primary **function** of this operation was to project power and maintain a stable maritime environment against emerging non-traditional threats. Hence, the correct answer is INS Satpura and INS Savit
